text: When a batch's repeated-failure stop is about an item that the scope guard has already paused, do not stop the batch: record it and move on to the next queued item. Keep the existing stop for every other repeated failure. This is the smallest version of the closed request 20261103-162416-m9th (whose plan grew too large); do not reclassify failures by cause here. Batches stopped this way twice today with money and job slots left. Acceptance: a test where an item fails twice, the scope guard pauses it, and the batch runs the next item; the existing repeated-failure test for an unpaused item still stops the batch.
